messages.content: Hi, I'm Tan Wei Jian, platform engineer dari tenant `t-myl-fintech-prod`. Saya nak register satu API baru — `MalaysiaPayments` v1, https, base path `/payments`. Owner team `payments-platform`, email payments-oncall@myfintech.my. Versioning by path. Tag dia `domestic` dengan `mvp`. Pastu saya nak define dev stage sekali, with INFO logging to ELK, 200 req/s rate limit, 400 burst. Boleh setup both in one go?

Selamat petang Encik Tan, terima kasih kerana menghubungi sokongan platform API gateway. Saya akan daftarkan API `MalaysiaPayments` dahulu, kemudian definisikan stage `dev` dengan konfigurasi yang Encik nyatakan. Mohon tunggu sebentar.
API telah didaftarkan. Saya akan teruskan dengan definisi stage `dev`.

function.name: define_stage
function.arguments: {"tenant_id": "t-myl-fintech-prod", "api_id": "api-myl-pay-9f3b21", "stage_name": "dev", "description": "Development stage for MalaysiaPayments v1, used by payments-platform team", "variables": {"BACKEND_BASE_URL": "https://dev-payments-backend.internal.myfintech.my", "ENV": "dev"}, "logging": {"level": "INFO", "destination": "elk", "sampling_rate": 1.0}, "throttling_defaults": {"rate_limit_per_second": 200, "burst_limit": 400}}

messages.content:
Terima kasih atas kesabaran, Encik Tan. Berikut pengesahan setup:

- **API ID:** `api-myl-pay-9f3b21` — `MalaysiaPayments` v1 (HTTPS, base path `/payments`, versioning by path)
- **Stage ID:** `stg-myl-pay-dev-44a2` — `dev`, endpoint **https://gw.taas.my/dev/v1/payments**
- Logging INFO → ELK, sampling 100%
- Throttling: 200 req/s, burst 400
- Tag: `domestic`, `mvp` | Data residency: `malaysia_only`

Adakah Encik ingin teruskan dengan konfigurasi route dan integration backend sekarang?

Yes. Tolong create satu route POST `/transfers` — auth pakai JWT, issuer `https://auth.myfintech.my`, audience `payments-api`, scope kena ada `payments:transfer:write`. Request mapping passthrough je. Lepas tu configure integration http_proxy ke backend dev kami `https://dev-payments-backend.internal.myfintech.my/api/v1/transfers`, TLS 1.3, timeout 5 saat, retry max 3 dengan exponential backoff untuk 502/503/504.

Baik Encik. Saya akan cipta route `POST /transfers` dengan JWT authorization, kemudian konfigurasikan integration `http_proxy` ke backend dev Encik dengan retry yang dinyatakan. Saya akan jalankan kedua-dua tindakan secara selari untuk mempercepat penyediaan.

Route dan integration telah disediakan, Encik Tan:

- **Route:** `rt-myl-pay-transfers-77c1` — `POST /transfers`, JWT (issuer `auth.myfintech.my`, audience `payments-api`, scope `payments:transfer:write`)
- **Integration:** `itg-myl-pay-be-dev-330e` — http_proxy ke `dev-payments-backend.internal.myfintech.my`, TLS 1.3, timeout 5000ms, retry exp backoff (200-2000ms) untuk 502/503/504

Sila ambil maklum: route dicipta tanpa `integration_id` terpaut secara automatik. Saya akan auto-link integration `itg-myl-pay-be-dev-330e` ke route `rt-myl-pay-transfers-77c1` sebelum kita plan deployment. Adakah Encik bersetuju untuk meneruskan plan deployment ke stage dev sekarang?

Yes, please plan deployment to dev stage. Low risk, single_stage blast radius. Include diff. Description: 'Initial MalaysiaPayments v1 dev rollout with POST /transfers and proxy integration to dev backend'. No approval needed lah, dev je.
Baik Encik. Saya akan janakan pelan deployment untuk stage `dev` dengan diff disertakan dan tahap risiko rendah. Mohon tunggu sebentar.

function.arguments: {"tenant_id": "t-myl-fintech-prod", "api_id": "api-myl-pay-9f3b21", "stage_id": "stg-myl-pay-dev-44a2", "description": "Initial MalaysiaPayments v1 dev rollout with POST /transfers and proxy integration to dev backend", "include_diff": true, "change_controls": {"requires_approval": false, "risk_assessment": {"risk_level": "low", "notes": "New API on dev stage, no production traffic impact", "blast_radius": "single_stage"}}}

messages.content:
Pelan deployment sedia untuk dilaksanakan, Encik Tan:

- **Plan ID:** `dpl-myl-pay-dev-20260521-01`
- **Risk level:** low | **Blast radius:** single_stage | **Approval required:** tidak
- **Diff:**
  - Ditambah: 1 route (`POST /transfers`) + 1 integration (`http_proxy -> dev backend`)
  - Diubah: tiada | Dibuang: tiada

Adakah Encik mahu saya teruskan dengan eksekusi all-at-once pada stage `dev` sekarang?
Yes, execute all-at-once, dry_run set false, notes: 'WJ pushed first dev cut for QA team to start integration testing tomorrow'.
Baik Encik. Saya akan laksanakan deployment all-at-once pada stage `dev` sekarang. Mohon tunggu sebentar.

function.name: execute_deployment
function.arguments: {"tenant_id": "t-myl-fintech-prod", "api_id": "api-myl-pay-9f3b21", "stage_id": "stg-myl-pay-dev-44a2", "strategy": "all_at_once", "dry_run": false, "notes": "WJ pushed first dev cut for QA team to start integration testing tomorrow"}

messages.content:
Deployment telah berjaya, Encik Tan. Pengesahan akhir:

- **Deployment ID:** `dep-myl-pay-dev-991023`
- **Status:** succeeded (durasi 31 saat)
- **Endpoint live:** **https://gw.taas.my/dev/v1/payments** — call `POST /dev/v1/payments/transfers` dengan JWT yang mengandungi scope `payments:transfer:write`
- **Smoke test:** 3/3 lulus

QA team Encik boleh mula menguji esok. Sila ambil maklum sekiranya Encik perlukan stage `staging` atau `prod` kemudian, saya boleh teruskan dengan canary strategy yang lebih konservatif.

Adakah ada apa-apa lagi yang saya boleh bantu?
